name: Wire Me Electric Inc
old_description: Wire Me Electric is a Reno and Lake Tahoe electrician that specializes in both commercial and residential electrical services. With our smart home and commercial licensed electricians, we are able to be a full service electrical company. Not only do we specialize in wiring high-end custom homes with smart home integration for residents, but we also provide tenant improvements for our commercial sites. As a full service electrical contractor, we offer all sorts of commercial & residential electric wiring services. From electric panels and low voltage wiring, to specialized wiring options for conference rooms, there's a lot our Reno-Tahoe electricians can do. We take much pride in what we can accomplish through our commercial & residential electric wiring services. Our licensed electricians in Reno and Lake Tahoe love learning more about the industry so they can share their knowledge and skills with our clients. Our goal is to provide the best quality wiring services possible, and in the process, create happy and satisfied clients.
about:
Wire Me Electric Inc. was founded in 2006 in Sparks, Nevada, by electrician Ben and business partner Christine Matlock, who serves as vice president and co‑owner. The company began as a residential and commercial electrical contracting firm serving the Reno–Lake Tahoe corridor, including Sparks, Verdi, Tahoe City, and Incline Village.

The firm provides a full range of electrical services: residential wiring for custom homes with smart‑home integration, low‑voltage and lighting installations, panel upgrades, and hot‑tub/spa circuits; on the commercial side it handles tenant improvements, warehouse power distribution, conference‑room wiring, and sound‑system cabling. A 15,000‑square‑foot warehouse project is cited as one of the larger jobs completed.

Customers include high‑end custom‑home builders, property managers, real‑estate professionals, and commercial landlords. Testimonials reference a Tahoe luxury‑property agent, a custom‑home builder, and a residential remodel client who praised the crew’s cleanliness and reliability.

The company emphasizes its Nevada state license (#85013), two decades of field experience, and a reputation for showing up on time, leaving job sites clean, and delivering competitive bids without surprise changes.
